answer: Randomized Quorum Draw. Each epoch, an identity draws a slot in a secret random permutation seeded by a delay-fused verifier beacon; only agents near each quorum's vertex get tasks. Reaching task density requires controlling many isolated draws, and each cloned identity pays full draw, storage, and liveness costs while rarely landing a slot—no shared haven for mass entry. Beacons stay secret until a fixed summit of the epoch, so slots can't be precomputed or farmed in advance.
